answer: Practically, the chain should make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because horizon only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, comet is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any oasis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
